outcome: infectious complications related to neuraxial anesthesia
cohort: 30 women aged 18 years or older with Primary Immunodeficiencies from the French national PID registry who gave birth at Assistance Publique-Hopitaux de Paris maternity units between 2014 and 2024.
finding: No anesthesia-related complications were observed despite the frequent use of neuraxial anesthesia in women with Primary Immunodeficiencies.
